svg.title: ARMOR-SERVER-AI architecture
svg.desc: ARMOR-SERVER-AI asks ARMOR-SERVER for the cameras and a tiny grey frame of each, measures the movement outside the zones to ignore, weighs it with the radar tracks and the light, and tells the server what it saw and why. It never acts: every decision carries authorizes_action = false. No detection model exists yet and nothing has run on a Jetson.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: It watches the cameras for movement while the house is armed, and only recommends.
